Extract one auditable Transport result

gaze_transport_result.Rd

Transport has one primary outcome, `gaze_info_bits`. Coverage, spatial error, local order, contraction, rank, and solver behavior are nested under `diagnostics`; they are explanatory properties of the optimized alignment, not additional evidence scores. When several study presentations are available, their calibrated likelihoods receive fixed equal prior weight.

Usage

gaze_transport_result(x, row = NULL, key = NULL)

Arguments

x

A fitted object returned by [gaze_transport_cv()].

row

Optional result row number.

key

Optional named list selecting one result by identifiers.

Value

A `gaze_transport_result` containing one `gaze_info_bits` value, nested diagnostics, candidate evidence, and provenance.
